description: Recipe ingredient parser and shopping list API: POST JSON {ingredients: [lines], servings?, targetServings?} (or GET ingredients=line|line). Returns per line name, canonicalId, qty, unit, metric (ml or g), category, optional/toTaste, prepNote, stated pack size, a typical pack hint, plus a merged shoppingList scaled to targetServings and unparsed lines. Deterministic, no outbound calls, no prices, nothing stored. Bad input (400) or nothing parsed (422) (Base: not charged; other rails may charge). Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).

ingredients.description: Recipe ingredient lines, one per item (max 100, 200 chars each)

servings.description: Servings the recipe makes (1-100); give with targetServings to scale

name: grocery_normalize
title: Ingredient List Parser
